description.en: Provides a DSH sidebar browser for local HTML and HTTP/HTTPS pages, with DOM element picking that inserts structured references into the Agent composer; local HTML also supports visual editing and saving.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地 HTML 与 HTTP/HTTPS 页面的侧边栏浏览器，可框选 DOM 元素并将结构化引用插入 Agent 输入框；本地 HTML 还支持可视化编辑与保存。
